authorised_by: THE USER, explicitly. The architect is gate owner and reviewer, not approver. This preregistration authorises NOTHING: the matrix requires an explicit stage token and an explicit --out.
what_this_stage_is: the closed-loop qualification of the J8 actor: exactly six declared rollout cells, three deterministic starts and three stochastic seeds, each 500 steps, each gated independently, aggregated once.
what_this_stage_is_not: a fit, an adaptation or any weight update
a PPO run of any kind
a promotion, a deployability claim or an authorisation of any next stage
a LOTO, LOCO, B1R1 or B1R2 study

operational_actor.never_edited: the actor is loaded read-only. It is never copied, edited, re-derived, re-fitted or projected. Its hash is checked before AND after the matrix.
operational_actor.no_other_file: the leaf holds exactly these six files; any extra or missing file is a fail-closed refusal

lineage.source: proven by the J8 receipt, not asserted here
lineage.july_role: METHODOLOGY AND EVIDENCE ONLY. No July weights, data or labels enter this stage.
lineage.verification: the J8 receipt is read and its recorded parent and dataset hashes are compared against these values

actor_contract.single_actor: one 35D actor. No standalone 25D artefact, no widening, no contralateral input.
actor_contract.controller_requirement: LIVE: every one of the ten must have a strictly positive norm. This is the J8 fit's outcome and the mask flip relative to J1/J2/J3, where columns 25:35 were still zero.
actor_contract.measured_in_j8: zero columns are exactly [0, 1]; all ten controller columns are non-zero

sigma.source: the J8 actor's own FROZEN log-std head: pi.1.weight[2:] is exactly zero and pi.1.bias[2:] is [-5.2983174324035645, -5.2983174324035645], so exp gives 0.004999999670722372 on both channels
sigma.never_edited: this stage never edits, copies or derives a log-std head. If the actor did not already carry sigma 0.005 the stage refuses.

runtime.builder: the hardened J1 builder, v26c_j1_collect.build_full_env_config and verify_env_config, reused unmodified
runtime.production_untouched: FSM, morphology corridor, reward, SEA and the C++ plugin are not touched
runtime.environments: ONE at a time, sequential, and closed FAIL-CLOSED after each cell: with no primary exception a failed close raises a J9Error CHAINED to the original cause, and the matrix fails technically without committing. When a primary exception is already in flight it is never masked, but close is still attempted. The success-path handler catches Exception, NOT BaseException: KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit are the operator stopping the run, not a technical failure of the environment, so they propagate unrewritten - while the outer cleanup catches BaseException and still removes the staging directory and the lock, so an interrupt is fail-closed too.
runtime.sim_outputs: production sim_outputs are required for every cell
runtime.ray_import_note: the RLlib checkpoint loader imports ray and torch at RUN time; importing them is not starting a cluster, a worker or an EnvRunner. The preflight imports neither.

penetration_authority.sole_binding: the 0.028 band is the ONLY binding penetration criterion. No local threshold is written anywhere in the runner.
penetration_authority.note: the pinned environment also terminates at grf_penetration_termination_m 0.028, so the binding band is enforced by the physics as well as by the gate

matrix.fail_fast_rule: a behavioural FAIL in any cell is PRESERVED and the remaining cells still run. Only a technical or integrity exception stops the matrix, and it fails closed.
matrix.order_is_frozen: A, B, C, D, E, F, in that order

offset_unit_correction.statement: the multistart offsets are SECONDS of episode start time, not radians.

primary_evidence.july_report: reports/user/2026-07-13_sblocco_actor_markov35_e_warmup_critic.md reports the starts as '-0.20 s' and '+0.20 s' and states the tests cover three starts of the SAME trial

offset_unit_correction.earlier_prose_error: several FROZEN earlier V26C records say 'rad' where the primary artefacts say seconds: v26c_j3_amendment_recovery_only.json, v26c_j6_amendment_recovery_probe.json, v26c_j6_amendment_recovery_probe_rev2.json, v26c_j7_prereg_markov_dataset.json, v26c_j8_prereg_recovery_fit.json and v26c_j4_recovery.py.
offset_unit_correction.no_numeric_artefact_affected: NO numeric artefact was affected. Those strings are prose describing a DEFERRAL; no offset value was ever computed, stored or applied from them, and every V26C rollout so far used the nominal offset from the pinned config. The error is descriptive only.
offset_unit_correction.remediation: those records are IMMUTABLE and are NOT edited. This block is the additive correction and stands as the authority on the unit.

deterministic.path: module.forward_inference -> get_inference_action_dist_cls().from_logits(...).to_deterministic().sample(); flat Box fallback is the Gaussian mean
deterministic.parity: the deterministic sample must equal the policy mean EXACTLY, and must match rollout_eval._policy_action_with_diagnostics bit for bit at every step
deterministic.stepped_with: the RAW action. The clipped action is a DIAGNOSTIC mirror and is never passed to the environment.

stochastic_held.source: rollout_eval._held_stochastic_action, the production helper, exactly as J6 uses it
stochastic_held.parity: forward_exploration and forward_inference must agree on the mean AND the std at every step, and the policy's effective std must be sigma 0.005
stochastic_held.identity: applied_noise must equal std * unit_noise bit-exactly
stochastic_held.stepped_with: the RAW action. The clipped action is a DIAGNOSTIC mirror.

env_mutation_policy.rule: the base env config is built and verified FIRST through the hardened J1 builder. Then ONLY episode_start_offset_s may take one of the three frozen values. Every other field must remain identical.
env_mutation_policy.proof: the set of differing keys must be a SUBSET of {episode_start_offset_s, output_dir}. Cells A/D/E/F normally differ only in output_dir, because their offset already equals the base one; cells B and C differ in both. Any other differing key, any added key beyond output_dir and any removed key is a fail-closed refusal.

reset_time_check.not_absolute_opensim_time: episode_start_offset_s is NOT an absolute OpenSim time and is never compared against base.t directly
reset_time_check.semantics: osim_trj_cmc_like._initialise_episode: max_start = max(cfg.t_start, cfg.t_end - episode_duration); requested = cfg.t_start + max(0.0, episode_start_offset_s); episode_start = min(requested, max_start); self.t = episode_start
reset_time_check.worked_example: cfg.t_start = 11.99 and the nominal offset 1.956870983805102 give an expected reset time of 13.946870983805102, which is exactly the time_before of J1's first recorded step
reset_time_check.tolerance_justification: the comparison is an exact arithmetic identity, so 1e-9 s is a cross-platform float-representation allowance, not a behavioural tolerance
reset_time_check.clamp_respected: the clamp to max_start is reproduced and reported per cell

input_sources.cross_check: the live episode_duration is compared against env_config['episode_duration'] with tolerance 1e-12; a divergence is a fail-closed J9Error, because the environment would not be running the episode length this stage configured
input_sources.why_live_is_normative: the clamp is computed by the environment from its OWN env_cfg. Reading our config instead would prove nothing about what the environment actually did.
input_sources.guards: a missing base.cfg, a missing cfg.t_start or cfg.t_end, a missing base.env_cfg.episode_duration, or a non-finite value are each an explicit fail-closed J9Error, never an AttributeError and never a guess

env_mutation_policy.no_second_j1_verify_on_mutated_config: J1.verify_env_config pins episode_start_offset_s to the pinned config's own value, including in its RUNTIME LITERAL CROSS-CHECK, so cells B and C would fail it for a purely technical reason. The contract is: the base is built AND verified in full by J1 BEFORE any mutation; a shallow copy then changes only the two allowed keys; and every other field is proved equal to the already-verified base. The verifier is never re-run on the mutated config.

per_cell_binding_gate.penetration: binding pass under the current contract, i.e. max penetration <= 0.028

kinematic_quality.ankle_min_direction: the ankle minimum must be AT OR BELOW -0.03 rad, i.e. ankle_min <= -0.03. More negative PASSES; -0.0099 FAILS; exactly -0.03 PASSES.

telemetry_integrity.status: a SEPARATE fail-closed TECHNICAL invariant, never a behavioural criterion and never a promotion threshold
telemetry_integrity.asks: is the recorded event evidence self-consistent (HS and TO counts at least the cycle count)?
telemetry_integrity.on_failure: the cell's qualification is technically INVALID - a statement about the evidence, never about the gait

diagnostics_not_binding: valid cycle count above the minimum

aggregate.pass_iff: 6/6 cells behavioural PASS AND 6/6 cells telemetry-valid
aggregate.any_other_outcome: FAIL or INVALID, preserved as evidence
aggregate.confers_nothing: an aggregate PASS is an offline closed-loop result. It authorises no promotion, no deployment, no critic warm-up, no PPO and no next stage.

multistart_disambiguation.evidence: reports/user/2026-08-25_v26b_b1r2a_revisione_indipendente_e_proposta.md line 149 defers the multistart MATRIX as a dataset-scope question; reports/user/2026-07-13_sblocco_actor_markov35_e_warmup_critic.md shows the July refinement that passed nominal and died at step 221 on the -0.20 s start, which is why the multistart validation is binding rather than deferred.

future_leaf.write_protocol: atomic commit, no-clobber under an exclusive sibling lock, modelled on J8: lock taken with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, sibling staging directory, verification, re-check of the leaf, then rename.
future_leaf.outcome_fail_still_commits: a behavioural FAIL still commits the full evidence and exits non-zero
future_leaf.cleanup_on_failure: recursive removal of the exact staging directory this run created, unlink of its own lock, and at most a NON-RECURSIVE rmdir of the parent if this run created it and it is empty

pinned_runtime_sources.why: these four files ARE the runtime this stage executes. Pinning them means verify_prereg authenticates their contents BEFORE any cell runs, so the stage cannot silently execute against a changed environment, a changed rollout helper, a changed env factory or a changed noise generator.
pinned_runtime_sources.Trajectory Generator/osim_trj_cmc_like.p: the environment itself. Pinning it ALSO authenticates the reset semantics this runner transcribes: _initialise_episode computes max_start = max(cfg.t_start, cfg.t_end - episode_duration), requested = cfg.t_start + max(0.0, episode_start_offset_s), episode_start = min(requested, max_start), self.t = episode_start. If that arithmetic ever changes, this pin breaks and the stage refuses rather than checking the reset against a stale rule.
pinned_runtime_sources.Trajectory Generator/baseline_MLP/rollou: supplies _held_stochastic_action, the production stochastic path, and _policy_action_with_diagnostics, the deterministic parity reference
pinned_runtime_sources.Trajectory Generator/baseline_MLP/env_fa: builds the environment from the verified env_config
pinned_runtime_sources.Trajectory Generator/baseline_MLP/explor: supplies HeldStandardNormal, which J9 imports and instantiates directly. Pinning it AUTHENTICATES THE HELD NOISE SEQUENCE of the three stochastic cells: HeldStandardNormal(np.random.default_rng(cell seed), action_shape, hold_steps=1) is what turns seeds 123/124/125 into the exact unit-normal draws each cell applies. If its generation or hold logic changed, D/E/F would silently explore a different sequence while still reporting the same seeds, so this pin breaks and the stage refuses instead.
pinned_runtime_sources.not_modified: this stage reads all four and modifies none of them
